subject: FiscalGrid: Console + API enablement — half-day timebox

Cc: samantha.lee@fiscalgrid.com
Date: Tue, 2 Oct 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Enablement - console + API (half-day)

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. FiscalGrid would like a focused half-day enablement covering the Console walkthrough (provisioning, routing, and monitoring) and an API enablement for our backend engineers to get keys, run simple generation calls, and understand batching/latency tuning.

Suggested attendees from our side: Samantha (product ops), myself (platform), and two engineers (Matt and Priya). We are in Pacific Time.

Are you available for either:
- Tue 10/5 morning (09:00–12:00 PT) or
- Wed 10/6 late morning (10:00–13:00 PT)

Would prefer a single consolidated block if possible. We also ask for a short preflight checklist we can run through before the session.

Thanks,
Jake
Jake Porter
Director, Platform Engineering
FiscalGrid

--

Hi Jake — great, thanks for the details and attendee list. Happy to run a consolidated half-day. Quick notes and two options from our side:

Option A: Tue 10/5 09:00–12:00 PT — Console (09:00–10:30), Break (10:30–10:45), API deep-dive + labs (10:45–12:00)
Option B: Wed 10/6 10:00–13:00 PT — Console (10:00–11:30), Break (11:30–11:45), API deep-dive + labs (11:45–13:00)

I'm cc'ing Jordan (will lead the API labs) and Ben (backup presenter and will cover routing/observability).

I attached a draft agenda (enablement-agenda-v0.3.pdf) and our short preflight checklist — can you confirm:
- Do Matt and Priya need sandbox credentials ahead of time (we can provision API keys for dev accounts)?
- Do you want the session recorded and the recording shared internally?

Once you confirm preferred option and attendee emails, I'll send a calendar invite with the materials.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
--

Thanks Hannah — we prefer Option A (Tue 10/5 09:00–12:00 PT). Recording would be great and yes please provision sandbox API keys ahead of time for Matt and Priya.

One small ask: can you split the API labs into two short hands-on exercises (auth + simple call; then batching/cache example) so our engineers can try the calls during the session? Also we may need a brief 15-minute preflight call on Mon 10/4 to walk through network access and test keys.

Appreciate it — Samantha
